Use your account permissions to clone, p.en: Use your account permissions to clone, pull and push over SSH as git.
Use your account permissions to clone, p.zh: 使用账户权限，以 git 用户通过 SSH 克隆、拉取和推送。

Paste a public key only. Keep your priva.en: Paste a public key only. Keep your private key on your device.
Paste a public key only. Keep your priva.zh: 仅粘贴公钥，私钥应保留在你的设备上。

No personal SSH keys yet..zh: 尚无个人 SSH 密钥。

Delete personal SSH key?.zh: 删除个人 SSH 密钥？

This key will no longer authenticate new.en: This key will no longer authenticate new Git commands for your account.
This key will no longer authenticate new.zh: 此密钥将无法再为你的账户认证新的 Git 命令。

SSH key title must contain 1–255 bytes w.en: SSH key title must contain 1–255 bytes without control characters
SSH key title must contain 1–255 bytes w.zh: SSH 密钥标题必须为 1–255 字节且不含控制字符

SSH fingerprint already registered as a.en: SSH fingerprint already registered as a personal key
SSH fingerprint already registered as a.zh: SSH 指纹已注册为个人密钥
